name: neural-path
description: Neural Path — Thai/English digital textbook for the 180-day practical AI Engineer curriculum (Day 1 prototype).

scripts.audio:d001: uv run --with google-genai --with lameenc python scripts/generate-audio.py d001
scripts.audio:b01-b02: uv run --with google-genai --with lameenc --with edge-tts python scripts/generate-audio.py d001 d002 d003 d004 d005 d006 d007 d008 --skip-existing --fallback-edge
scripts.audio:upgrade-b01-b02: uv run --with google-genai --with lameenc python scripts/generate-audio.py d002 d003 d004 d005 d006 d007 d008 --skip-gemini --stop-on-daily-quota --delay 22
scripts.audio:daily: uv run --with google-genai --with lameenc python scripts/generate-audio.py --all --skip-gemini --upload-supabase --prune-local --stop-on-daily-quota --sync-registry --delay 22
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
